name: SaunaLife X2 | 2-Person Traditional Indoor Sauna
description: Description The SaunaLife XPERIENCE-Series Model X2 indoor home sauna kit was created by leading sauna designers and engineers as a premium-quality sauna at a remarkable value. The 2-person X2 sauna boasts a level of quality far superior to other sauna kits, with a beautiful glass front wall. Create a luxurious wellness retreat in your bedroom, basement, or any spare space in your home. Innovation - Luxury Made Affordable The tempered glass full front wall showcases silky-smooth, furniture-grade Aspen benching and backrest which are surrounded by bright and welcoming Nordic Spruce walls and ceiling. A sturdy footrest matches the seating and can provide additional seating. A large, professional-grade door-pull and robust hinges underscore the attention to detail of this beautiful home sauna. Illumination – Sauna Ambiance High-quality dimmable LED lighting is dotless for a more elegant appearance and indirectly illuminates the sauna interior from behind the backrests. The lighting is controlled by a portable remote control. Intention - DIY Simplicity Pre-assembled wall and ceiling panels make assembly simple and result in a professional-quality finished appearance. The Model X2 Home Sauna Kit is designed by SaunaLife and precision-crafted in Northern Europe where sauna bathing is a healthy part of everyday life. Enjoy a lifetime of wellness in the comfort of your own home and Live the SaunaLife ! Designed to exceed expectations, this open and airy sauna benefits from a full glass front. It is furnished with a dual-level bench and backrest constructed of furniture-grade Aspen. It offers a white LED lighting system that is Wi-Fi app-based.
